title: Pure Naturia
summary: Pure Naturia control build with only Naturia cards and generic staples. Small EARTH Insects and Plants tribute themselves to summon from the Deck or negate opposing effects, while the Level 5–7 Naturia Synchros shut down Spells, Traps, and monster effects without once-per-turn limits.

summary.title: Starters
points: Naturia Mole Cricket tributes itself during either Main Phase as a Quick Effect to Special Summon a Naturia from the Deck (or two if the opponent controls the monster with the highest ATK on the field), and revives itself when the opponent summons from the Extra Deck or you summon a Naturia from the Extra Deck.

Naturia Camellia is a Level 4 Tuner that sends a Naturia card from the Deck to the GY on summon, replaces Naturia monster tribute costs by milling 2 cards from the top of the Deck, and revives a Naturia when the opponent Normal or Special Summons.
Naturia Sacred Tree (Limited) tributes an EARTH Insect or Plant to summon the other Type from the Deck, and searches any Naturia card when sent to the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Naturia Mole Cricket
steps: Normal Summon Naturia Mole Cricket and tribute it to Special Summon Naturia Camellia from the Deck.
Camellia sends Naturia Sacred Tree from the Deck to the GY; Sacred Tree searches Naturia Blessing.

Activate Naturia Blessing to revive Naturia Mole Cricket (or save Blessing for the opponent's turn to Synchro Summon Naturia Beast or Barkion); when Mole Cricket hits the GY again or an Extra Deck monster is summoned, Mole Cricket revives itself and can tribute off by milling 2 cards via Camellia to summon Naturia Sunflower and Naturia Vein.

summary.title: Camellia Cost Replacement & Negation Loop
summary.text: Naturia Vein tributes itself and another Naturia to negate a Spell or Trap activation, while Naturia Sunflower tributes itself and another Naturia to negate a monster effect activation. While Naturia Camellia is on the field, once per turn you can send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the GY instead of tributing a monster to activate a Naturia effect, letting Sunflower, Vein, or Mole Cricket resolve their first effect while staying on the field.

summary.title: Synchros, Fusions & Lock
points: Naturia Beast (Level 5) sends the top 2 cards of the Deck to the GY to negate and destroy any Spell activation; Naturia Barkion (Level 6) banishes 2 GY cards to negate and destroy any Trap activation; Naturia Landoise (Level 7) sends a Spell from the hand to negate a monster effect.

Naturia Exterio (fused via Naturia Blessing using Beast and Barkion) banishes a GY card and mills 1 to negate any Spell or Trap, while Naturia Gaiastrio negates any effect that targets a single card on the field.
Naturia Bamboo Shoot, Tribute Summoned by tributing a Naturia monster, locks the opponent out of activating Spell and Trap Cards completely.

summary.title: Spells, Traps & Left out
points: Naturia Blessing Special Summons a Naturia from the hand or GY, Synchro Summons using monsters you control, or Fusion Summons a Naturia Fusion Monster at Quick-Play speed.

Naturia Forest searches a Level 3 or lower Naturia monster whenever you negate the activation of an opponent's card or effect, and Exterio's Fang is a Counter Trap that negates a Spell or Trap while you control a Naturia.
Left out: Naturia Rosewhip is Forbidden in the TCG, and the page's Runick and Vernusylph engines are omitted in this pure build.
